ledger: skatepark concrete bowls/banks/ledges | street-course ramps left, bowl edge left-front, ledges mid-ground at start | bowl corner and transition under skater at end | geometry remains coherent as camera travels; coping edge occludes skater's lower body correctly when he drops in

perimeter tree line | dense green trees ringing the park, behind ramps in all directions | same continuous ring at end | trees sweep across frame in the direction opposite camera travel, consistent with a circling fisheye follow-cam

tall light poles | cluster of gray poles behind skater at start, one thick pole right-of-center mid-clip | poles shift to frame-left as camera circles | apparent 'splitting' of one pole into two around 00:05.5 is ordinary parallax separation of two depth-offset poles, not a layout change
round concrete tables (2) | visible right of frame at 00:00 only | out of frame thereafter | camera advances past them; never reappear, no contradiction
distant low buildings | visible through trees left and right at start | same buildings reappear across the bowl at 00:08.6-00:09.6 | background through/behind the bowl matches established perimeter

skater (moving entity) | riding toward camera, center-frame | riding down bowl transition, center-frame | continuous trajectory; emerges on correct sides as camera orbits; occludes poles/trees behind him correctly

skateboard (moving entity) | under skater's feet at start | under skater's feet at end | occludes ground and is occluded by skater's legs plausibly through both flip tricks; never renders behind background elements it passes in front of

camera path | low fisheye follow, front-facing skater | low fisheye, trailing/side view at bowl | single continuous take, no cuts; all background panning is consistent with smooth camera translation and rotation
